//: Non-secret config for the dev-database rotation CLI. Safe to commit. Run `pnpm db:discover` to fill in ownerId.
//ownerId: Render workspace id (tea-... or usr-...). Leave empty only if your API key sees exactly one workspace.

database.name: cinego-dev-db
database.//ipAllowList: REQUIRED for external access. Creating via the API does NOT apply the dashboard's default rule, and an empty list silently blocks every external connection — TCP connects, then the TLS handshake is dropped. Narrow these CIDRs if you only ever connect from known networks.

ipAllowList.description: Dev access (matches the Render dashboard default)

service.name: cinego-backend
service.//useInternalConnection: Point the deployed service at Render's internal hostname. Only safe when the service sits in the same region and workspace as the database.

//allowedPlans: Hard guardrail: the CLI refuses to delete any database whose plan is not listed here, so it can never destroy a paid or production instance even if misconfigured.
